Name: Item Recovery Plus
Author: Lunardiver
Description:
Just died in the Skull Cavern and lost both your sword as well as some other valuable items? Worry no longer as this mod allows you to recover all items you lost when talking to Marlon instead of just one!

To keep things a bit balanced though, the prices have been adjusted to equal what you would pay in a normal shop for them (so e.g. 50,000 G for the Galaxy Sword instead of a mere 1,300 G in vanilla).

For those interested, you can find the source code of this mod [url=https://github.com/LunarDiver/StardewValley.ItemRecoveryPlus]here[/url]. If you're interested in translating this mod, please make a pull request in that repo with the translations you made. How you can help with translating can be read up [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations]here[/url].
